rules.name: Lateral Movement: RDP Followed by Credential Access
rules.description: Correlation rule detecting rdp followed by credential access
rules.query: CommonSecurityLog | where (Protocol == "SMB" or Protocol == "RDP" or Protocol == "WinRM") and SourceIP startswith "10." and DestinationIP startswith "10." and SourceIP != DestinationIP | summarize count() by SourceIP, DestinationIP, Protocol, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)

rules.name: Lateral Movement: SSH Followed by Privilege Escalation
rules.description: Correlation rule detecting ssh followed by privilege escalation
rules.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID in (4672, 4688) and (Process contains "sudo" or Process contains "runas") | summarize count() by Account, Process, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
